transcript.statement: Ethical and compliance considerations are vital for the RollCall system, ensuring adherence to regulations and promoting accountability. RES-05 keeps students informed of their attendance status, promoting social responsibility. RES-06 implements role-based access control for authorized access only, and RES-07 ensures compliance with educational regulations on historical data retention. These requirements collectively uphold ethical standards and foster trust in the system.

requirements.text: The system shall comply with data protection regulations when handling student attendance data.
The system shall log all attendance changes with timestamps and user identification for transparency.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days.
The system shall ensure attendance reports for administrators include anonymized data to protect student identities.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement role-based access control to regulate attendance data access.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five years for compliance.
The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization using energy-efficient methods.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time under 3 seconds.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds within 1 second to user interactions.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing operations.
The system shall support cloud storage solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers.
The system shall allow for real-time attendance updates using low-energy communication protocols.
The system shall verify the integrity of attendance data through checksums or hashes.
The system shall maintain an audit log of all access and modifications to attendance records.
The system shall enforce session timeouts to log out users after a period of inactivity.
